subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be rebased and consolidated into existing availability/depth-aware sub-agent guidance, changed into a coherent no-nested-spawn policy, or closed manually as already covered?
rationale: The branch is small, but it changes maintainer-owned model-facing prompt policy where current main already has overlapping guidance and supports configured nested spawning.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into existing Tooling, Messaging, child-prompt, or tool-description surfaces after rebasing.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and every prompt surface together.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: Treat current main guidance as sufficient and close this stale protected branch manually.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into existing Tooling, Messaging, child-prompt, or tool-description surfaces after rebasing.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the maintainer-labeled proposal and already made the product-direction call against the related tool-policy approach.
